title: The Gold Key
text: {{name}} is in the garden today. There is a key in the grass. The key is gold and bright. It shines in {{name}}'s hand. {{name}} is very curious now. Look! There is a tiny door in a tree. {{name}} puts the key in it. The little door opens. Wow! There is a small room there. A little bird sits on a rock. The bird is shy and quiet. {{name}} sits down and waits. {{name}} smiles at the bird. Then the bird starts to sing. The song is soft and clear. {{name}} laughs and claps. The bird is happy too. Now they are good friends. {{name}} comes back every day to play.

questions.prompt: What does {{name}} find in the grass?
What is in the little room?
What does the bird do at the end?

summary: 主角在花园草地上发现一把发光的金钥匙,用它打开树上的小门,里面有只害羞的小鸟;主角耐心坐下等待并微笑,小鸟终于为主角唱起歌,两人成了好朋友,主角每天都来玩。
